One thing that is impressive about Marylove is that she is unbelievably responsive. Almost every time I sent her a message, I got her reply right away! Since we stayed at two different houses (the other in Kailua Kona) during this trip and the beds at the other house were not very comfortable, I think it is important to mention that the beds at Marylove's house were very comfortable. Everyone loved Marylove's house and her service and we would definitely book her house for our next trip.

Mary love is a generous hostess and opens her lovely home to stay in . She recommended places for us to see and made us very welcome and comfortable. Thank you , Marylove!
We really enjoyed our time with Marylove, she was so friendly and helpful

We spent 6 wonderful days here! The location is great: 10 minutes away from the end of hwy130 for the lava flow viewing, and 15 minutes away from the Issac Hale Park, the warm tide beach. We could find everything you need in the place, and the design and decoration is amazing. Marylove is a great host: we didn't meet her until the last day of our stay - because of Christmas season - she provided useful information for check-in and our stay, and can be easily reached via inbox mail. Would definitely recommend this place!

Wow! This place is an amazing deal! Close to the ocean, so close you can smell it in the air. Easy going, Aloha style neighborhood. The local town is a short drive away, Pahoa, which is rich with surfer culture and basic needs. Mary Love's place is a short walk from whale watching and beaches. Her place offer all the basic needs and so much more.  Like a fullly stocked kitchen & beautiful comfortable beds that make you feel like Royalty. A great outdoor area that holds space for that deep relaxation feel. Close by are so many amazing spots that its easy to keep busy exploring. MaryLove was exceptional in helping us find where things are and when special events are happening. Her personality is very relaxed & positive & she is an exceptional hostess. Best instructions for using everything like switches and so forth, lots of things are labeled. We can all appreciate clarity. Overall the best priced for value place in Hawaii.

Marylove's place is very comfortable with access to a full kitchen! The lanai is a great place to start or end the day.  Marylove is full of great information and tips about the area. Communication was great and prompt. Thanks Marylove!

We had a wonderful time staying at Marylove's place.  She is warm, friendly & full of excellent information on the area.  She has a beautiful home which is so comfortable to stay in.  I would highly recommend staying with her & experiencing the Puna area of The Big Island as it is "special" is sooo many ways.

We had a lovely stay at Marylove's. She totally deserves the 5 stars that she has. Very nice host, flexible and understanding, gave us tips and indications all with a big smile on her face. The property is in a quiet area, the house is very nicely decorated and gives you the feeling of peace and spirituality. Highly recommend this accommodation for any kind of travelers be it couples or friends traveling together. We will surely miss it.

Majestical is all one can say for our restful stay at Mary Love's abode. The house offers a perfectly peaceful retreat. The location is fantastic. It is close to black sand beaches, the lava flow, fresh markets, warm pools, tide pools and Kalani retreat center. The room was immaculate and Love provides all things you didn't even think to bring. The house is fully stocked with all the fun extras. Mary Love is also an experienced host and is knowledgeable of happenings in the area. She is welcoming, available, gracious and unobtrusive. I would not hesitate to book a room, or the apartment. We were also thrilled to use the Sondors electric bikes on the beautiful red road for an experience of a lifetime. Mahalo Mary Love!!!!

Belle grande maison spacieuse et bien équipée pour couple et/ou famille qui désirent passer du bon temps dans un endroit situé près d'attraits touristiques intéressants (coulée de lave, bassins naturels, plage de sable noir, etc.).

Notre famille a été accueillie avec amour et générosité. Les enfants ont adoré chercher des lézards et jouer avec les jeux de société. Nous, les parents, avons adoré prendre nos petits-déjeuners et notre apéro sur le patio magnifiquement aménagé.

Thank you for everything! Your place is amazing and so are you!

La famille Doyon-Mathieu
XXxxx

A lovely home and such a nice host! She offered us tips on how to get to places and helpful ideas to fill our evenings with! The house was beautiful and very close to the coast with a beautiful view! We stayed there for a week and had an amazing experience with no problems!

What an amazing vacation we had in Hilo. MaryLove is an amazing host with a beautiful place. She made us feel like family and was helpful with awesome suggestions on things to see and experience while on the island.
Amazing place, very clean on arrival. They were always available for any questions we had. It was a great stay!

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay, Bailey was a fantastic host, extremely accommodating. The property and location was better than we expected.
Bailey had stocked the fridge and pantry with a few of the essentials for our arrival, a very welcoming touch. Bedrooms and living areas were large and very comfortable. Tranquil location, with beautiful views of Pittwater.
Looking forward to our next stay at Bailey's place.
we loved our stay in avalon. place was amazing. views were great and the community was just lovely

Amazing house with direct access to the beach and private jetty. We had a ball! (Website hidden by Airbnb) you can think of IS in the house. This is not one of those properties that have "RENTAL" written all over it, this is a HOME. 
Breakfasts on the verandah overlooking  the water and the sound of waves crashing against the shore is something special. 
The house is large enough for a large group, where everyone is comfortably accommodated yet have enough privacy to feel completely disconnected from the group due to the bedrooms being located over three different levels. 
Tip: you might want to grab a sleeping eye mask as it get pretty bright in the house once the sun is up.

Loved our stay at Bailey amazing home in Avalon! The quality of decor and all his pieces throughout the house very tastefully done. Didn't want to leave and the view from the deck is breathtaking. Down a few steps off the deck and you are swimming in the clear waters of Pittwater.
Accommodated our large group very well and hope to return again. 
Thanks Bailey for the starter pack in the kitchen. Yummy! Great host! 
Cheers Liz

An awesome and amazing house that just made for such a relaxing and easy weekend away. The view is just stunning and the house is very nicely decorated with all the essentials. Loved that the house had access to a private beach. Bailey was so easy to communicate with and always replied promptly to any questions. Thank you for making our stay so lovely.

Bailey was a great host! 
He responded immediately to the reservation and got us out of a sticky situation! 
The house is absolutely amazing! Has beach acess and the best view of Pittwater! We had the best backdrop and wedding photos! 
The house is super clean! Modern and comfortable beds. The 4 levels and total of 14 bedroom just gave everyone that extra room to breath and space to move! 
We will definitely be back!
Great place, very special spot. Private access to the beach and spacious home, great for large groups. Go for it!!
Beautiful, tranquil location on beach. Excellent for entertaining and kids. Place was very clean and well-appointed.
One of the most amazing places I have been to. 100% recommend it

Had a great stay! Fitted our extended family very comfortably and we loved the location and the balcony view. The inclinator made things easy for our elderly guests as the house goes over several levels. Bailey was a great communicator and Paradise Beach is a quiet place to swim and full of character!

Our family enjoyed a fantastic stay at Beach Escape to celebrate my mum's 60th birthday. 
There was a lot of planning and logistics in the lead up to our stay and Bailey was always prompt and accommodating with questions. 
It's a great house for a large family, offering us the perfect bedroom configuration for 9 adults and 4 kids as well as plenty of living space so we weren't living on top of each other. 
We loved the beautiful Pittwater views and dining outdoors on the large deck facing the view.
Beach Escape is also pet friendly which meant all our family were welcome. 
It was fantastic having the amenities of Avalon only 5 mins drive away but feeling like we were in a quiet secluded area far away from the hustle & bustle of Sydney. 
There's plenty of pedestal fans but no air con & blinds on west facing windows made for a hot stay on the days that reached almost 40 degrees. But it meant we made the most of the wonderful harbour beach down the stairs. 
Would highly recommend Beach Escape to large groups.

This house is perfect for a large extended family group. It has so much room that you can go off and have a quiet time by yourself even if the house is fully occupied. The beds, bedding and towels are high quality, and the kitchen has everything you need to cater for a large group. The private beach and the hot tub are wonderful for just hanging out and relaxing. The house's many levels mean that even crying babies don't disturb others in the house.
Waking up to the gorgeous views of the trees, boats and water can't be matched. I would highly recommend this house and would come back.

A very large home that can genuinely handle a larger group. Lots of retreat areas so people can spread out. Location is the quintessential waterfront Pittwater experience. The host was good on the communication and any issues or advice quickly addressed. Highly recommend this property

We were made to wait almost two hours out the front without any information from the host as to how to get into the house. Thursday was my actual birthday and this almost had us packing up and heading home - we were minutes away from cancelling the weekend as we had no way of getting in to the house we had booked for 12 guests. We then get inside and everyone starts to arrive and we all shower and use the toilets. By the time we come out the smell of raw sewage is so unbearable that we can't use the balcony for the dinner we had planned or open any windows on a hot day in a house that has no air con (not that air con was ever listed or promised however). The smell only got worse throughout the weekend as we continued to use the bathrooms. 6 out of 12 guests chose to leave on Friday as a result - ruining the weekend we had planned for my birthday. Two of the couples who left had travelled interstate for this. So they had paid for 3 nights and only got to stay 1 in rooms that stunk of sewage. This could have and should have been resolved on Friday or Saturday - but no solution was offered and we were expected to stay in a house that stunk of sewage. On top of this on Friday, as we bring items down from the car into the house we place two cases on a shelf along the kitchen wall and it comes off completely and lands on my foot. After looking at how it was constructed, a 30-50kg shelf was screwed together by 4 small screws and was never constructed to hold any sort of weight, making it a danger to guests. And lastly, the alarm. At 2.30am on the Saturday morning the house alarm (that we had been told did not work) began going off and woke everyone in the house. The four surrounding suburbs encountered a blackout and as a result the alarm went to auxiliary power and then went into alarm (the blackout is obviously not the owners fault) The alarm continued to go off for an hour and there was no information anywhere as to how to make it stop. We were left to figure this out for ourselves. The number we called inside the panel had no idea, the host was not contactable and the lady he put us in touch with suggested "we push a couple of buttons". The house should not have been rented out with the sewage pump the way it was and the host should have information on hand for his alarm system. We know that the host MAY not have known the pump was broken, but we did make him aware as soon as we noticed it within a couple of hours of arriving and no solution was offered for the three day stay. If we had...

A wonderful home away from home. There was enough space to cater and allow for our family of seven couples with little ones in tow. Beautiful view and location. The kiddies loved having their own private beach and bird visitors of cockatoos, kookaburras and lorikeets every day. Just a note to make sure the fridges are cleared of food prior to the next visitors stay.

This spacious property is truly amazing with stunning features and beautiful views on every level. Bailey's hospitality was exceptional. I would highly recommend this property for a relaxing holiday, especially for large groups of 6 or more.

Location is to die for and the beach perfect for regular visits. Great for little kids. The view from both living areas and many of the bedrooms is spectacular. Becuas each room is so beautiful, there were not arguments about who got which room. The living space is one of the most beautiful homely area for relaxing. All in all a most spectacular house.

We had a group of 13 and all had a great time there. The house was clean and well equipped from the bathrooms to the kitchen. The house was spacious and having 4 bathrooms between a large group was definitely handy. A few items including milk and soft drinks were supplied and left in the fridge which was a nice touch. Can't fault this house. We all had a fun and memorable stay!

This house was so beautiful! The location was breath-taking and the house was a delight. The house plan is very well thought through, clean and homely. Our group loved the weekend away, would highly recommend. The host was also very accommodating :D

What a great time! We will definitely be back. We stayed over with 5 families and each of us had our own space to hang out and relax. The property is very family-friendly and even our dogs had a fantastic time frolicking on the beach. The beds were super comfy and our host Bailey was available at any time to answer any queries promptly. Thanks Bailey, looking forward to the next trip. Highly recommended!

A wonderful spot! We had 10 adults and 5 children in our group and we all had a wonderful time! There were lots of living areas so everyone could have their own space. The private beach was a hit with the kids and adults alike. Amazing sunsets, and we kept warm with the log fire. The kitchen was on the small size for the size of the house - in saying that, I would happily return!

We had the most amazing time. The house was perfect in every way to accommodate our large family. The location is central to everything and right on the beach. It was also perfectly for the children.
The water views were stunning, the living space was beautiful with the open fire place and the beds were really comfortable.
We can't wait to return and stay there again, it was truly the most perfect place.
Thanks for a great stay Bailey! The house was amazing and miss waking up to that incredible view! Would definitely stay here again.

Great location spacious accomodation 
Great views
My wife and 4 kids had a great week in the house. Location and house were both great and Bailey sorted out everything we needed. Highly recommended!

Bailey has been an absolutely perfect host - he has gone out of his way by providing everything you would need to stay here. The house is amazing and the views and location are spectacular. It is all of the little things that made our holiday feel just like home. I would highly recommend staying here with families and friends.

Beautiful home, the pictures don't do this place justice. The spa overlooking the water at sunset - absolutely perfect. Very spacious, amazing views of the water from all the rooms. Close to the supermarket, restaurants, bottle-o. Great location. Perfect size for 10 guests, and would comfortably accommodate 14. Bailey was great with communication. Can't wait to plan another stay, will definitely recommend to friends and family.
Beautiful views, spacious living areas and sleeping quarters, quiet neighbourhood. Very little to complain about. Bailey is very responsive and helpful for any queries.

The house is as described and more.  We hosted our mums 80th birthday here and she was blown away by the location.  We had 14 family members staying all having their own great size rooms and areas so we did not feel on top of each other.  I would recommend and will be back again.

This place looks great in the photos but really exceeded our (Website hidden by Airbnb) was perfect for our family group of three generations with bedrooms on different levels and a number of living spaces. It was spacious, comfortable and stylish and such an idyllic location. Bailey was a great host. He promptly responded to our questions and we really appreciated the early check-in and late check out. We really didn't want to leave. Highly recommended. Many thanks Bailey.

The celebration of our Mum's 90th was made very special by a magnificent house in an amazing location. The house had everything we needed or could wish for.  At one stage we had 12 people and it never felt crowded.  All communication was clear and very prompt - a great host.

This is a wonderful house in a stunning location. We celebrated my 60th birthday here over the weekend. We were a large group of 12 adults and 2 toddlers and the house suited us perfectly . We liked the multiple living areas and we had all our meals on the gorgeous balcony overlooking the view . The 3 fridges were much appreciated. 
It was fabulous to have our own beach with the toddlers !

The house is amazing, spread over four levels and with spectacular views of Pittwater. We used the house as a base for our wedding in Avalon and it was perfect to have family all stay under the same roof as well as to get organised in the morning of our big day.

The hosts are great and are quick to respond to messaging and with Netflix, Fox and wifi available it was easy to entertain the kids.

Thanks again, we hope to come back someday to relive such an amazing time away.

A lovely house with great views over the bay and water. Lovely bedrooms, lounge areas and large decks for relaxing. Stairs down to the private beach and sea pool.
Built down the hillside with multiple levels with a self-contained area on lowest level. Although quite a few stairs - only an issue if anyone has mobility restrictions.

A group of 11 of us (all adults) stayed at Bailey's place last weekend for a wedding, and it was amazing! I would highly recommend staying here. The place is exactly as described, check in was super easy and Bailey was very responsive and chilled out. The views were breath-taking, we had plenty of space (most couples had own bathrooms or shared between 2), and the beds were really comfy too. Pretty much had our own private beach as well! All in all, a very relaxing stay and perfect place to escape and unwind. Thanks for a great stay Bailey :)

Brilliant location and house is spacious and very well thought out. Bailey is always around to help out if you have any questions.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

A beautiful home in a stunning location. Perfectly located close to everything but very tranquil and peaceful. Visited by birds, galahs, cockatoos and lorikeets every morning. The house was so comfortable for 10 of us, so much room and lots of privacy. Couldn’t have asked for a better house for our family reunion. Bailey was very amenable with check in and check out.  We had our grandmother who loved the inclinator, young kids who adored the beach and the wildlife, and adults who enjoyed their evening cocktail on the beautiful balcony watching the sun set.  A perfect house for everyone. Thanks for a memorable stay.

Such a tranquil location with stunning views everywhere you look. The house is perfect for a large group and communication with Bailey has been fantastic, he has been very quick to respond. A little car juggling may be required however a small price to pay for this top location.

Our stay at Beach Escape was terrific. The location is incredible and although it doesn't have it's own private jetty, there is a public one 100m away. We spent the days boating on beautiful Pittwater and at the basin and retreated back to the house at dusk. Bailey's house in fabulous, with incredible views across Pittwater. Each level has a lounge room and private space for guests. We certainly would love to come back and stay at the Beach Escape.

The situation of this house on Pittwater with steps down to a small, perfect beach and swimming area is astounding.  Every evening we watched the sun set from the main terrace, through the trees, over the boats and behind the hills on the far side of the bay.  Although slightly tired, the house was robust and very well designed, cascading down the hillside with light, views and seating areas at all levels.  Everything worked (excellent shower pressure) and we especially appreciated the enormous supply of soaps, shampoos, white towels and stripey beach towels.  We will return as often as we possibly can for more of this magic.
This is a perfect getaway beach house. The beach is right below the house and at night there is a warm jacuzzi to relax. Highly recommend to stay at this house if with a huge family!

We absolutely loved staying at Bailey's amazing beach palace. You couldn't have asked for a better location overlooking the water. The layout of the house is unique and the styling is chic. We thank you bailey for your hospitality.

Wow what a place! We had the most amazing time staying at this property. Bailey the host was very easy to deal with and was quick to help with any issues we had. The access to the beach from the property made our stay. It’s a perfect beach to relax the day away and great for the kids too! The house is huge and can easily accommodate large groups or a few families without getting in each other’s space. The location is beautiful for walks, some amazing houses and greenery to look at. Also there is a cute little cafe just up the road for morning coffees if needed within walking distance. The main town is gorgeous with lots of shops and cafes to keep any one occupied. Loved our stay. Thanks so much.

This was an amazing property that impressed all of our guests. The house was very well presented and clean. Everything was provided and much appreciated. We unfortunately had a rainy week but made the most of the spa. The multi levels made for a great way to get some privacy and shift people around for entertaining. We will definitely book again.

Bailey’s place is exceptional and comfortably fits 14 people without feeling like you’re living on top of each other. There are spacious rooms on each floor and views from every level. We absolutely loved staying here and thoroughly recommend it to anyone.
Amazing house & location. I suggest you prepare ahead so that you take everything you need, as in groceries with you, and then stay, relax and unwind! We’d definitely stay again.

This is a superb place. We had family visiting from overseas and the generous space was perfect for our group. All bedrooms are well-appointed and beds are incredibly comfortable. The house was very clean, and the kitchen had everything we needed. Views over Pittwater are spectacular - we enjoyed swimming and soaking in the spa - and the neighborhood is quiet. The walk to Avalon Beach is easy and peaceful. Bailey was a great host - check in and check out very straightforward. Would love to stay here again sometime!!
Beautiful spacious house on the waterfront. Whether inside or outside there are plenty of great areas in a fantastic location. Different floors allow guests your independence. Would recommend

A perfect retreat with perfect view! We were a big group and yet didn’t feel on top of each other. The outdoor hot spa with view over Pittwater was definitely a highlight. The direct access to the beach was a great bonus. Bailey was a fab host, very responsive and accommodating. Some of the cabinets and drawers could be more tidy and the bbq wasn’t cleaned properly, but we had a fab stay overall and would recommend the house to other travellers. We’ll definitely love to stay again.

Thanks bailey! Your home is beautiful myself and my guests enjoyed every hour of our stay. There were so many rooms and levels that we could just have our time if we needed. Everything about the trip was perfect I would defidefinely come back, perhaps in summer this time!
Bailey is very responsive. Beautiful place and awesome location. Highly recommend!
Need to get away with some friends to chill and connect? Baileys beach escape is perfect! Beach off the back garden, tonnes of room for time to yourself and great views from nearly every room.
Amazing property, great host & perfect location!
14 lovely ladies had a lovely time at this beautiful house with amazing views from almost every room,location is perfect close to many amenities and activities.
Really enjoyed the place and its location. The place was amazing!

Wonderful long weekend away at Bailey’s house.

Beautiful beach front location with amazing views from the spa and outdoor eating area. 

Everyone had a comfy bed and their own bath and beach towel. Plenty of pillows and blankets. 

So much space for a large group - lots of little hideaway areas to relax / get privacy.

So many thoughtful extra touches such as body wash, shampoo and books to borrow! 

Highly recommend.
The house is lovely. Lots of bedrooms and separate living areas, so great for a large group. We had a wonderful stay. Thanks so much. Highly recommend

Baileys house is great there are many areas to have your own space. Beautiful view and decor very relaxing and tasteful. Can’t wait to stay again! Thanks again
Chris & Marcia Allen

Absolutely stunning house and location ! Great accomodating host! Perfect place for our wedding weekend! 

Thank you Bailey !

This is a tremendous location for a weekend of pure enjoyment. The house has everything from delightful living spaces to cosy bedrooms and a view ovewr Pittwater which cannot be  beaten.  Couple this with your own little beach and you have something special.

Thank you very much. 
We really enjoyed and this was absolutely great  & fantastic place for us.

Recommended!
Great place with plenty of space. Would definitely stay again.
House is run down needs maintenance spa didn’t work deck rotten next to spa kids foot nearly went through. House cleanliness not to satisfaction

This place is amazing!! The house and views are better than expected and everything is provided so all you have to do is relax or for those that’s up for adventure there’s so much happening around the area. Bailey has been great and we have already booked to stay again during the new year weekend!

Bailey’s home on Whale Beach is gorgeous. Palatial and nuzzled into a hill, it is essentially a vertical house with many bedrooms and lots of different common areas to relax, including three decks. The home is extremely comfortable and I highly recommend it. Plus, Bailey was incredibly nice and communicative while planning our stay. Overall a 10 out of 10!

Again we had an amazing time. The place was clean, beds were comfortably and checkin was a breeze. The view and backyard down to the beach is what this place is all about!  Bailey is a great host, we will no doubt stay again. Just a note for those that cannot stand heat the place has no air conditioning so it gets very hot during day and night but there are fans and the beach right at the doorstep to cool off.
The house was amazing, as were the views. A really lovey weekend with friends. Wish we could have stayed longer.

Such a beautiful home! Perfect for friends or families as there is so much space to have a bit of time apart. The location on the beach and the hot tub were added bonuses! We walked down to Clareville Kiosk for a delicious dinner as well. Such a perfect weekend! Thanks Bailey :)
Bailey was an outstanding host. Easy to communicate with and the house is amazing. What a spectacular view! Thanks Bailey.

Nice beach escape! Lovely view to wake up to each morning.  Many areas to gather with the family. Might get a little hot in the summer tho, as there is no air-conditioning. But many fans provided. Place needs a little more maintenance but overall still cozy and nice. Good responsive host too.
We had a great weekend. House and location are beautiful

Very great location and surprisingly quiet inside! Clean and comfortable loft. Good location !!!
Yanick was always quick to respond and to answer any of my questions. Merci et a bientot, j'espere !

Yanick was a great host, very accommodating to our schedule, which was really appreciated. His loft was great. Location can't be better in the heart of old Montréal. Very comfortable and clean, it is a great choice whom was going to visit Montreal and enjoy the beautiful charm of old Montréal!

My friend and I stayed at Yanick's place for four nights.  Yanick was very quick to respond to our questions, and very helpful overall.  He showed us where to find good parking, and checked in on us to make sure things were okay during the trip.  The place was even bigger than it looked in the pictures, and just the perfect size for our needs.  It was clean when we got there, and the bed had fresh sheets and there were towels for us to use.  One thing we wished for was sheets for the futon, since we were not sharing the bed.  There was also no space for us to unpack, because the bureau drawers were full.  Other than those two things, the place was great and not stuffy at all, though it was on the fourth floor.  It's also in a great location, very conveniently located near lots of good restaurants, the waterfront, and the bike path along the river.  We would definitely recommend this to anyone, it is WELL worth the price!

When I first saw the location and price, I thought this sounds too good to be true. But it IS true! The location is in the middle of everything picturesque - cobblestone streets right when you step out, Old Port and Old Montreal your neighborhood, around the corner from City Hall and numerous restaurants with scenic patios. You can cross the street to Bonsecours Market, or walk 5 minutes to Notre Dame Bonsecours Chapel and about 10 to Notre Dame Basilica. If you want more than what's immediately walkable, Champs de Mars station is very close. If you drove like we did, there is paid street parking around you for short term stays, and many lots to choose from for overnight stays. We personally liked the indoor garage on Gosford and Champs de Mars streets.

As for the loft itself, it has beautiful views of Old Port and Old Montreal, as well as a comfortable mattress and futon. It is well kept, and Yanick will provide you with wifi, a refrigerator full of cold water bottles, along with towels and linens. The pictures are exactly how the loft looks. He will also respond to any messages within a couple of days prior to your arrival, and within an hour or so during your stay. Logistics very easy for check in and check out.

This location may be the best in Montreal. The place is nice and cozy. Only one problem with the sound, there was always small noise of the air conditioner but if you are not stay at home a lot, it should not be a problem. I will come back if I have a chance

Yanick m'attendait  quand je suis arrivé , l'appartement est conforme à la description , sur le vieux port ,rue touristique de Montréal.
bien situé pour allez courir , plein de restaurants autour si on ne veut pas cuisiner, c'est le studio habituellement occupé par Yanick,parfaitement rangé pour l occasion.parfait pour un couple ou
une personne seule ,qui cherche une location centrale .

Loft très lumineux, spacieux pour deux, bien agencé. Nous avons passé quatre belles journées à Montréal grâce à ce pied à terre merveilleusement situé.
Yannick, indisponible, avait organisé notre accueil et
s'est tenu au courant de la bonne marche de notre sejour.
Un seul petit problème : le bruit de la climatisation. Heureusement  la température baissait bien la nuit et nous pouvions l'arrêter.
Yanick was a fantastic host.  He was very communicative and helpful.  The apartment was clean and had everything you could want to enjoy some time in the heart of Montreal's historic Old Port.

We arrived in Montreal a bit late and were fortunate to have international cellphone coverage to message Yanick about our late arrival. He was patient enough to wait for us in the apartment as we navigated around the Old Port to find parking. He spent 15-minutes explaining the accommodations before leaving us with the keys.

The closest overnight parking (1.5 blocks away) is at the Hotel de Ville (Montreal City Hall) and costs 18.75 $CAD per 24-hour period. This is a deal in terms of closeness. The apartment is in walking distance to great restaurants, the waterfront, the Clock Tower beach (our favorite spot to hang out), and public transportation. 

The apartment has excellent air conditioning and met our needs. The bed was comfortable, Wi-Fi was excellent, bathroom was clean, and air conditioning was wonderful during the warm summer days. It's a great location and we would stay here again.

It was a wonderful experience at Montreal. The place is at the heart of old port. Everything is within walking distance, kitchen is highly functional, a comfortable bed, washer/dryer and mostly I like the showers- it relieved all fatigue after a long walking. I highly recommend this place!!!!! 
Why wait? This place would make your visit to Montreal good to better!

Yanick's place was the **perfect** home base for a weekend escape to Montreal. I stayed for two nights with a friend. The location can't be beat for tourists -- it's literally around the corner from Place Jacques-Cartier and a few blocks from the Metro. As a host, Yanick is a real pro. He was responsive, flexible with check-in/checkout time, and left a fully stocked bathroom. The loft is beautiful, clean, and modern. Full of light. A+, would book again. Thanks Yanick!

I had a great experience in Montreal.
Yanick was very friendly and had a beautiful apartment. I texted him with any questions i had and he responded right away. The apartment is located in old port and the street- st paul- where the apartment is full of life - restaurants and bars galore

Yanick's loft is just as described in the listing--right in the middle of the Old Port section of Old Montreal, just steps from the Bonsecours Market and many pleasant restaurants and shops and convenient to the Metro. It's a bustling area, very pedestrian friendly--but quiet enough late at night to sleep with open windows. The place is small but not at all cramped. He has a lovely, up-to-date kitchen with a fabulous Nespresso maker, and he left the refrigerator stocked with water, juice and milk. Yanick is quite personable and welcoming. I arrived earlier than expected and he was most gracious about the mixup. He was also available by text when I needed to ask  where he stored a couple of household items.

Yanick’s place was perfect for our quick getaway! Right in the heart of Old Montreal, we were a few steps away from numerous bars, restaurants, shops and the water. Yanick was very accommodating welcoming me at his place.

Yanick is a lovely host. He gave us a low down of the neighbourhood and was flexible with our schedule. I would definitely stay here again (what a great location!).
Excellent location for new years eve, enjoyed staying in the heart of old Montreal

it was a great neighborhood and easy to find! thanks yanick

Yanick's place was great! The loft is nice and cozy, just as it looks in the photos. Fantastic location, so close to Old Montreal. Very comfortable condo. Great restaurant downstairs.

Nice place on Old Montreal. Thanks Yannick

Carol is a wonderful host - fun, informative, flexible and extremely helpful  to our needs! We would love to stay with her again soon!

The 2BR apartment has a lovely tropical ambiance with lots of light and being on the upper floor, quite peaceful. It is clean and well maintained. It has a great location in Lahaina close to all the shops and restaurants.

We had a lovely time in Carol's condo. There was five of us and it was a good size and clean. It has a great location in Lahaina. It is just a four minute stroll to the seafront where all the restaurants and shops are. There are two swimming pools at the condo's complex. 

It was easy finding free parking out on the street in the evenings if you have a car. You can also choose to pay and park in the complex but we didn't feel it was necessary.  

We found it very helpful that there was a small both by the pool that was occupied by a very friendly member of staff who can give you advise about anything on the island and can also book activities for you.

Carol was very easy to deal with and quick with responses. Everything went very smoothly. We would definitely contact Carol again regarding accommodation.

A little tip is that there is freshly brewed coffee in the mornings by the pool.

Super convenient location in downtown Lahaina. We were able to walk to the pier for our whale watching excursion and to Front Street for restaurants. The 2BR/2BA is spacious, clean and there's a pool in the complex. Plenty of towels and fresh bars of soap were provided. We found street parking out front easily on the weeknights, but on the weekend we ended up paying the $20 to park inside.
What a wonderful condo, and wonderful host! Perfect spot on Maui. Close to everything. Would definitely stay again in the future.

The location of the condo in the Aina Nalu is convenient. We could walk to the wharf for our whale watching excursion, the bus stop to Ma'alea was close by, restaurants were fairly easy to get to and the shopping on Front Street were also easily accessible. The location was about the only thing we enjoyed out of this accommodation. The unit in itself was not very well cleaned (or... cleaned OUT more like). We found old ice cream and water bottles in the freezer from previous guests. There were also several old combs in my bathroom when I opened some of the cabinets, the 2 bathrooms weren't cleaned very well (my sink was filthy and my friend told me that the toilet bowl hadn't been scrubbed in her bathroom) and our towels were stained yellow. As for our host, I really have no comment as we didn't see her at all, through check-in, during our stay or as we were checking out. I don't entirely feel the money I paid was worth staying here.

We were extremly pleased with the condo.  It was (Website hidden by Airbnb) were the grounds & pools. 
 The only ONE negative would be the $15.00 a day to park..but, we just avoided that by parking on the street. It was not a problem to find a spot.
You are sooo close to downton Lahiana - a short 2 blocks.  We walked (Website hidden by Airbnb) was GREAT!

We so would stay here again~

Absolutely beautiful condo! The pictures do not do it justice. It was well-equipped with so many amenities- dishwasher, coffee maker, toaster. Not close to the beach, but less than 1 block's distance to downtown Lahaina with great shopping and restaurants. 

The only negative is I would suggest buying your own toilet paper- no extras there and the coffee pot makes only about 2 cups per pot. We were briefly locked out for about 40 minutes, but it wasn't anyone fault and Carol, the owner, was great at fixing the mistake right away. 

HIGHLY RECOMMEND BOOKING THIS GREAT CONDO!!!

This place was awesome.  We loved our stay during our entire trip.  Carol was a very generous and gracious host.  She was there upon our arrival and gave us some great ideas for things to do, most of which we ended up doing.  She provided plenty of beach towels and even supplied an aero bed when we asked for it.  The condo is beautiful and the grounds are just lovely.  The pools and hot tub where a nice way to relax after running around all day.  If I ever go back to Maui, I will be staying here again for sure!

Location, Location, Location! The condo we rented was amazingly close to the main street in Lahaina. It was great for 4 people (each couple had their own bathroom). It was clean and easy to find. My only word of advice would be to budget for the cost of parking as street parking was difficult to find. However, don't let this stop you from using this condo. Carol was a great host and made the trip easy to plan!
Great place, it had everything we needed and more!

This is a fun condo complex - centrally located in Lahaina where you can walk to bars and restaurants. Its not right on the beach or anything but nothing in central Lahaina really is. The saltwater pool and surrounding area is fab. It was a great place to meet people and theres even a tv so you can watch games from the pool.  Although we were missing some amenities when we first got there, Carol was immediately responsive and got us what we needed. We enjoyed our stay.

In general, the location was great, the overall condo complex was just fine, and the unit was fine.

Unfortunately we had several hiccups over the course of our stay, and Carol did her best to remedy them, but wasn't able to remedy them all (e.g., we never had cold water from the faucet in the master bath). 

I think that's the risk anyone takes when booking a room on airbnb vs. a hotel (with more dedicated maintenance staff), but I've usually had rock solid experiences with Airbnb.

Condo is very nice with two comfortable beds and spacious bathrooms. It's also located near the main area for Lahaina - so very convenient. Carol was great in coordinating our arrival. Everything went smoothly and we had a nice time.

The condo was lovely, and the beds were so comfortable. We had access to whatever we needed, and the beach and shops were so close we just walked down the street. We would definitely stay there again.

Durante los dias que estuvimos alojados, nos hemos sentido como "en nuestro hogar"!!!. 
El Condo se encuentra muy bien ubicado: cerca del centro y de la playa (solo un par de cuadras).
 Las habitaciones, mobiliario, decoracion y confort fue mejor de lo esperado (hasta disponiamos de sillas playeras!).
GRACIAS!
Wonderful experience, everything was good to go. Carol was extremely helpful and responsive. Location was close to everything.

We booked the apartment for 6 adults (turned out to be actually 7) to have a nice base for all different activities on Maui (beach, snorkeling, shopping, hiking, hang gliding, sightseeing and going out for dining).
We were not disappointed; Carol's apartment is well located very close to downtown Lahaina in walkable distance to restaurants and bars.
Also the common BBQ area allowed for the whole group to prepare food and to dine outside together (area accessible until 10:00pm)!
The small dishwasher was very helpful to quickly clean all dishes to be ready for breakfast inside the apartment.
We were very happy to have Carol's place as a base to explore all areas of the island of Maui!

We stayed at Carol's apartment for 7 days and were satisfied 100%. The Condo is located in the really nice Aina Nalu Resort. It is very nice, spacious with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, equiped with everything we need and everything was as described. The location is great, very close to the main area for Lahaina within walking distance to many good restaurants, bars and the harbour. Everything went smoothly and we had a great time. We definetly will recommend staying at Carol's place and will come back next time.
Carol was a great host and the condo was perfect, great location and just as described in the add.
We had a great stay with our family. The accommodations we're great - just as described. Thanks for everything

Everything went very well.  Condo is nice, pool areas are great, and location is primo.  Awesome to walk to restaurants, shops, and bars.  Only problem is parking. I had an awesome experience and would definitely do it again!!
Carol was great to work with.  There was an error with the room set up and she was quick to respond and have it fixed.  The accommodations are exactly as described.  I recommend working with Carol!

This was a beautiful condo. Very well stocked. Walking distance from everything in Lahaina, but far enough away where you felt like you were off the beaten path. We had an amazing time and I would definitely stay here again.

It was very easy to check-in to the condo. It was very clean and well-stocked. The location was within walking distance to restaurants, shops (including the outlets), and the beach. We were able to find street parking for the whole duration of our stay (6 days). Carol helped us in a timely manner when we had minor issues arise, and accommodated our request for a late checkout with a small fee.
The place was great. Exactly what was advertised. Carol was extremely nice and accommodating.

Our stay with Carol was very pleasant. Although we didn't meet her in person, she was very responsive and gave us detailed check-in information both over the phone and via text. The condo's location was the best part, as Lahaina's restaurants and shops are just a few blocks away. The condo was as described, with more space than we were expecting. Carol was a wonderful host and we had a fantastic time in Lahaina!
Yes the apartment was as described and very well 'fitted out' with everything you would need for a holiday by the sea.

This was a perfect base to explore Lahaina & Maui.  The condo is lovely, comfotable, and well-appointed for an easy time. Carol was very responsive to questions and information requests. Instructions were clear and helpful.  We would highly recommend this wonderful property!

Our stay at Carol's condo (G104) million was very nice. We made good use of the Infinity pool & hot tub (there are actually two pools). The location is excellent.  It is within a couple of blocks of the market & Front street.  Although we did not meet Carol in- person, she responded quickly to our texts  in regards to questions or requests.

The condo accommodated 4 people nicely (with the exception of having only 2 stools at the counter).  Kitchen is well equipped if you plan to eat your main meals at nearby restaurants.  If you plan to do more cooking, bring storage bags or containers.

We definitely would stay here again.

A wonderful condo in the perfect location! The unit was beautiful, the pool was great, and Carol was very responsive and easy to deal with.

The condo is clean, comfortable and in a good location. There were extra towels for the pool, a full kitchen, all the amenities of home. It's a really nice place. The main strip of Lahaina is conveniently a little over a block away.  
The downside is the condo is right next to the highway. If it was on the lower level the wall would block most of the sound, but it is on the second level above the wall. I honestly never really got any sleep due to the vehicle sounds from the highway. When it was quiet the fan in the master bedroom squeaks. As I was in and out of sleep I would awaken to the alternating sounds of truck air brakes releasing and the continuous squeak of the fan.
Yes eventually you would get use to it, if you lived there year round. But staying only 4 days, my wife and I could not ignore it. Not a single full night sleep was had by either of us.

Unit A-207 was a lovely spot to enjoy Lahaina & escape the heat. The buildings are old-style with lots of louvered glass windows, so yes, there is some noise coming in from other guests. However, this was mainly during the day (pool closes at 9pm) & didn't bother us. We enjoyed the closeness to Front St. Kitchen is well-equipped and all the furniture was very comfortable. Nice amenities including pool towels.

This condo is beautiful. Large comfortable beds, everything you need in the kitchen. Air conditioner was a life saver! Fantastic location, only a short walk to Front Street. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Great condo, great spot! 
Thank Carol for all you've done to accommodate us

The condo is very well placed at the center of the town, very pleasant with everyrhing you need. Moreover checkin and checkout were very easy based on code share; Carol was very prompt to answer my request and questions.

Just perfect for your stay at Lahaina !

The condo has a great lay out and felt spacious.  We are a family of 6 and it fit us perfectly.  There were plenty of towels, a closet full of beach gear and plenty of food prep supplies.  Walk a few blocks to Foodland and pick up some groceries and you are set. 
 We enjoyed using  the grills by the pool one evening.  There was an older couple out playing dominoes and a resident, who is a surf instructor grilling along side of us. 

We were very content at Carol's condo and plan to return.

Place was comfortable and located in a very convenient location in the heart of Lahaina. Good bang for your buck in the center of a desirable location during the holidays.
Can't beat the location! Perfect walking distance to downtown Lahaina. The condo was clean and comfortable. Thanks Carol!
This place is awesome! My favorite trip so far.
The place was great and close to everything that we needed.

The rooms are spacious and comfortable. 2 bedrooms and 2 restrooms, and we cooked by ourselves every night. Safeway is only 8 minutes drive. It's quiet, but is very near to the busy Front Street. The environment in the Aina Nalu is also beautiful. Finally, Carol is very patient and responsive.

This resort is in a great location with lots of amenities. The pools were amazing! Well kept grounds and lots of parking (if you're willing to pay $20/day).

Also, I requested a first floor unit, because I was traveling with an elderly parent, but was given a second floor unit anyway.

The condo was really nice location, close to Front Street. Just walking distance to the historic buildings, fancy shops and restaurants. The Italian restaurant "Penne Pasta" very close to the condo was our favorite. We could park free on the street during our stay but it might be a little bit difficult to find the space to park in high season. Anyway we had absolutely nice holidays in this condo. Thanks Carol.

The development is a beautiful collection of two story buildings with gorgeous landscaping and two pools - one large with a hot tub and a large cabana area, the other smaller and prone to early (and welcome) shade. It is possible to walk to the beach, but not pleasant with kids and all the accompanying supplies. We drove to a couple of different beaches while we were there. 

Carol was a perfect host - responsive instantly by text but otherwise we had no interactions with her and were left to enjoy our vacation. The unit was stocked with plenty of towels, beach chairs and mats, and all the dishes and supplies you need. 

Thanks for a great visit!
Convenient, tasteful and well worth a return visit....I wouldn't change a thing

Quiet, but close to everything. Foodland only 5 min, Front Street only 3 min away.

Very nice, clean and well-equipped unit. So close to front street.

This condo was great!  Awesome location, walking distance to everything, 2 amazing pools.  Very clean when we arrived and had everything we needed provided.  Checking in was super easy and pain free.  Would rent again for sure!
The location is perfect for easy access to both of the pools located on the property as well as a quick 2 minute walk to Front Street with all of its amenities.

Great location to Lahaina’s main streets. Quiet, clean, and spacious. Easy to check in, and quick response from the owner.
Great place, beautiful location, great sized unit for two small families! Would definitely visit again. Carol was very attentive and responsive. Lahaina is an amazing place to visit.

This was our first Airbnb experience so I was a little nervous. But, it was a fantastic place, as described, very clean and any question I had was very quickly answered. Loved it! I’d take my family here again.

This is a truly amazing place to stay. Staying in old Lahaina is really like old Maui, not the new Kaanapali "super hotel hustle" feel. Aina Nalu is secluded a few blocks off Front street (the main drag in Lahaina) in a very quiet neighborhood. It literally takes just a few minutes to get to the old Banyon Tree and the harbor which are the center of all activityin Lahaina. Walking to and from is not only refreshing, but extremely convenient. Lots of shops and restaurants are super close by.
The unit itself is very nicely adorned with full amenities including washer/dryer combo, fridge, TV's in every room, a master suite and a 2nd bedroom. The carpet looks very new and we tried to keep our shoes/flip-flops at the door to help maintain the fresh look. The couch is quite comfy and it is just a very nice place to stay. We did not go to the pool area to swim, but it looked clean and kept up and there seemed to be people there everytime we passed by, so in good shape.
The Outrigger folks are friendly as well. The only down side is the parking fee which we found out is paid to the landowner not the Outrigger, so that explains they can't really give you any discounts because that is just passed on to the landowner. 
This is a place we will definitly return to. Oh, also, if you're suba diving, Lahaina Divers is literally a block and a half away so very easy to get to, and they are amazing. 
A whole lot of Aloha going there! Great place to make your Maui vacation relaxing and memorable.
The space is great! Good location. Good value.

Good location, close to Front street and various good places to eat. Street parking is free and worth holding onto your spot if you find one. Was clean with a few basic amenities. Laundry is a nice bonus. Carol communicates quickly and had no problems with the stay. Would recommend anyone looking for a central location, its a very popular building among tourists.
Great spot! Would definitely recommend

Carol is a great host. We had a 15 month old grandchild joining us for a few days and Carol provided a booster chair with play toys and a crib for sleeping. You will be happy to find how quickly Carol responds to any question or issue before you arrive and during the 10 days we were there.

Great place and great value! Lots of nice amenities provided like beach chairs, boogie boards, snorkel gear and beach toys. Very short walk to Front Street in Lahaina. Fairly short drive to the beaches in Ka’anapali. The grounds/pool area are very nice. We chose to park on the street to avoid the $20 daily parking lot fee. Easy to find spots on week nights...more difficult on weekends, but manageable. Carol was easy to communicate with and returned messages quickly. Would definitely stay here again!

Location was excellent - a quick walk from Front Street and even Old Lahaina Luau. We enjoyed the pool and BBQ areas. The unit itself was clean and comfortable. Carol was great - quick to respond and very accommodating. Made the whole process of check-in easy and hassle free.

C104 is a great condo for families. The beach chairs and accessories are great. Carol, the manager, responded immediately to a dishwasher water leak and was genuinely concerned about our comfort and needs. The location is ideal for Lahaina town shopping and dining. We would stay in C104 again. Thank you!
Such a nice unit and great location to both the pools! We had a great time and would definitely rent from Carol again.

The location (right in Lahaina) was fantastic. We could easily walk downtown, to the waterfront, and to restaurants. The place was just right in terms of space - two bedrooms with some living space. And amenities - two swimming pools.

Very family friendly, with beach chairs, boogie boards, baby needs. Grounds are beautiful, well kept. Both pools are nice. Neighborhood is very quiet considering how close it is to Main Street. Most of what you need is walkable, restaurants, shopping, beach. Easy to book, & communicate with Carol.

Carol was an amazing host. She was very professional and provided quick and prompt responses to all our questions and concerns. Her place was beautiful and well kept. Her kindness made this a very pleasurable experience. I would highly recommend her to friends and family in the future.

Great place. Very comfortable and convenient to everywhere we wanted to go.

Great location, easy check in, the unit is lovely and has everything! We will stay there again if we go back to Maui! Beware the paid parking there though, signage not terribly obvious and we saw another guests car get towed!

We enjoyed our stay at this condo. Carol was quick to reply with my questions and access info. The place is so close to Front Street. The pool and lanai were very nice. Sitting in the pool under the stars was really relaxing. The landscaping was amazing. Would stay again for sure.

Everything positive that folks are reporting is completely accurate!  The home is really a luxurious place (in our opinion!) and we loved staying there!  The pools are fantastic, everything is within walking distance and there were quite a bit of food staples provided.  We had 2 kids with us and they thoroughly enjoyed staying there as well!  There is air conditioning and fans in each room, along with a washer/dryer and washing soap is provided.  It was fantastic!
Carol‘s apartment was very nice and clean located in the heart of Lahaina. We loved our stay and will come back every time we will be on Maui.

Clean and quiet. AC in every room worked well and was a must in the Lahaina summer. Loved being able to walk everywhere- what a beautiful town Lahaina is!  Thoughtful touches like spices and extra toilet paper. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. Thanks Carol!

There is air conditioning throughout the place and the beds are very comfortable.  Carol has provided plenty of linens, towels, coffee pot, tea pot and all the basics needed for a comfortable stay.  I would definitely recommend this place. We spent 4 nights in Istanbul at Kerem's apartment, and wish we had stayed longer! We'll have to come back another time.

The location is perfect—maybe 3-4 minutes from Galata Tower and from the Shishane metro stop. Many interesting and unique shops around, lots of coffee shops and restaurant options, etc. Not nearly so touristy as across in Sultanhamet: the area has a 'real' feel, and there are very few buskers. I'd highly recommend this place (and area) for a first time in Istanbul, even though of course you'll have to head over to Sultanhamet to see Topkapi and Hagia Sophia, etc.

The apartment itself is recently-renovated, all fixtures work great, nice shower. Kitchen is small but serviceable—in any case there are so many good restaurants nearby that we only cooked breakfast here—and there's a washing machine and A/C unit and heaters if you need them. It's a little bit off Istiklal street, so there is not much noise at night or in the mornings ... except for whichever neighbor it is who thought a doorbell that played the first few notes of Für Elise at high volume would be an awesome idea. Somehow this particular sound goes right through the walls, despite it otherwise being adequately soundproofed. 

Bed is comfortable, Internet is fine, host is readily available, etc. I'd stay here again the next time I come to Istanbul, and if all the apartments are rented, I'd definitely still stay in this area.
Kerem's place is excellent, in a very good location.
Very nice apartment and Owner! Quite and in very center. Felt in love with the Galata tower area :)

The location of the apartment couldn't be any better, close to the Galata tower, and the shopping street. Kerem was very helpful, recommended us places to visit and to eat at, and answered all our questions.

Great location, very close to Galata tower, not far from tourist areas and ferries. A lovely apartment, great bed and shower and kitchen. Comfortable sofa. Air conditioning in lounge only. Kerem is an amazing host; so friendly and helpful. Highly recommended

The apartment is the perfect location for exploring Istanbul. It's nearby some tourist sites with easy access for walking or public transportation to others. The place is in a quiet alley so you get the feel of the neighborhood. Kerem was a fantastic host, very easy to communicate with. The apartment has everything you need and was very comfortable. I would stay here again anytime!

Cozy, clean, central, super quiet, easy access, secure, full equipment - everything i would like to have in an airbnb home. Kerem is always available for any communication, his "being there" all the time gives comfort and a relaxed mind. Was a good experience!

The apartment was wonderful! Its situated right between the Sishane metro stop and the Galata tower, so it is super convenient and close to great coffee shops, Istiklal, Karakoy, the Galata area, but its also somehow secluded and private. Kerem was great and super responsive and helpful! I would stay here again! I loved the neighborhood!!

Kerem was extremely easy to communicate--even while he was undergoing surgery during my stay--and he made me feel VERY welcomed. There's nowhere else I'd consider staying on my next trip to Istanbul.
Everything was perfect!!! Karem was so helpful! He even met me and helped me with my bag! The apartment is so cute and cozy! I will certainly be back!?
I highly recommend Kerem's place. Checking in was easy, the place is spacious, clean and very well located. I would definitely stay here again next time I go back to Istanbul!

Kerem’s place was the perfect apartment for exploring Istanbul. It is in the middle of a hill and up three flights of stairs so be prepared to hike, but it’s well worth it!

My wife and I had a great stay in Istanbul, and much of it is thanks to Kerem's place. The place was clean and had all the amenities we needed. It is strategically located in the Beyoglu area, which is good for shopping and eating out. We particularly liked to just walk around Istiklal street. It is also not too difficult to get to the Grand Bazaar and Spice Bazaar.

Kerem himself was helpful with the questions we had. He did not personally meet us, but he gave us his contact number and we communicated using (Hidden by Airbnb) .

Be warned that the apartment is on the fourth floor and that the stairs is narrow and steep. While Kerem's apartment itself is good, the main entrance is in a small cul de sac which was not so presentable. We used Efendi Travel for the airport transfer to the apartment and the driver took a while to find the place.

I strongly advice that when it is time to leave for the airport, call the taxi or Uber at least three hours before your flight. For some reason, the driver of our first Uber request cancelled our request. Then, based on Kerem's advice, we downloaded the taxi app BiTaksi and requested for taxi to the airport. Twice, the taxis we requested ignored us. The app had a map and we could see the taxis were moving away instead of coming towards us. We suspect it is because the taxi rate was too cheap to the airport, and so they thought it was not worth it to take us. Finally we made another Uber request and this time the Uber car arrived and took us to the airport in time.

All in all, Kerem's place is very good value provided you are okay with going up the stairs.

I stayed at Vicky's place as I was visiting HK for a conference in City University, for 6 days. It is so close that I could go there on foot, and that is why I chose it. However, the location itself appeared to be great: the neighborhood around was magnificent, a very vibrant area, with extremely cheap and nice restaurants, street food vendors, shops etc everywhere. And actually, not touristic at all, you are going to see how local people live around there. Especially Mong Kok, which is just a little bit south, I really enjoyed walking around in the evenings. There are plenty of bus stops around, and the subway is at most 5 minutes away.

The place was also very nice. It was nice to see how common houses there look like and live there. Do not expect high luxuries or something, it is just a normal house. For me, it was a very nice place and adequately clean. There is also kitchen but I did not use it; there is tons of great and cheap food around, so there was no reason to spend time cooking (but Vicky one cooked and shared)! In general, I did not experience any negative issue regarding the facilities of the house.

Vicky provides with a sim card with unlimited internet, so it is even better than just having wifi in the house, as you can have internet in your smartphone or laptop everywhere you go. This helped navigating around the city a lot.

Vicky and her flatmate, J., were really nice and friendly. Initially, Vicky gave exact and clear instructions on how to get there. Both gave quite many suggestions on what to do in the city, and I even spent time with them. Both seem very interested in interacting with the guests, as long as they have time, of course. 

Overall, I am really enjoyed my stay there. I enjoyed being in that location and walking around. Everything concerning the house was working fine, making my stay in Hong Kong comfortable. Also I am very happy to have met Vicky and J., and enjoyed our interactions. I would certainly recommend.

You don't want to leave a bad review when the host is friendly and the price is low, but the truth is that the neighborhood is a slum and the apartment was unclean. I was not able to sleep when I was there because it was cold, and the bed blanket was very thin.  I could also hear everything going on in the living room . The neighborhood was depressing. Several people warned me about walking alone in the area late at night. I ended up spending a lot of time and money looking for an alternative place after I arrived in Hong Kong. It was close to New Year's Eve, so I had to return to this place for the last nights of my stay as I could not find an affordable hotel room. I cannot recommend this place.

First the good things
 The location is very very central, it is very safe, and the doorman is great
 There is a laundry in the building on the entrance floor and it automatically  includes soap. The apartment is very quiet for the area. Although I never met Yi in person she was always accessible to communicate. The room was very sparse but functional wifi was good.

The place has 3 bedrooms, a common living room with a table, a Chinese style kitchen and a very tiny showering area with hot water which is typical of Hong Kong apartments. There is a functional  TV. The price  is fantastic, cannot be matched.

Now the not so good. The place is the most dirty place I have ever stayed at in HK, and at one point I lived for many years in HK. Yi mentioned the cleaning fee was for the bedrooms only and also no towel is included, which I believe she listed but I did not notice.  The place is good for backpackers and undergraduates. The entire week I was there 4 to 5 men and women stayed there and I can state the bathroom was never cleaned. The kitchen looks like a tornado hit it, and some of the grime is that thick amber tacky stuff from years of grease buildup. The living room is a thick dusty mess, the sheet covering the couch reeks. I had no idea someone, an airline stewardess who I never saw, had her personal things there and in fact the apartment was her home.  I borrowed a mirror left out on the table, and ate some crackers that I mistakenly thought were left by previous guests and it caused huge problems but I immediately returned the mirror and replaced the crackers.

All in all a mixed experience. I am sure others saw what I saw, but did not mention the messy aspect in their reviews. I am not being picky, but I wish I had know before I booked what I would actually encounter.

 Still it is a good deal, best walked into with your eyes wide open and a high tolerance for filthy common areas.

I stayed 5 nights in this apartment. Location is very close to Prince Edward Station (exit A; Tsuen Wan Line) and Shek Kip Mei Station (exit A; Kwun Tong Line) so it's very convenient. There are supermarkets, bakeries, and local eateries around the area.  Laundry facilities are located within the building. There is a lift to the apartment, which is a relief for travelers with heavy luggage. Inside the apartment, there's a kitchenette, which is good for getting hot or boiled water. Wifi connection is strong within apartment. Inside the bathroom, a shower curtain separates the shower and toilet areas. Hence, some people might feel cramped while showering. The room that I booked has windows and is equipped with strong aircon. Overall, I enjoyed my stay in this apartment. This is a very good area to experience local Hong Kong life where one can see elderly folks, mummies with children, blue collar workers, and of course office workers mingling with each other. Though this area in Sham Shui Po is not posh, its down to earth vibes makes this place very real.

房东是个很好沟通和交流的年轻姑娘,房间位置也很好,环境不错,用餐,看维港夜景非常方便｡干净整洁,适合一家三口,尤其是六七岁以上的孩子出门｡
