We haven't met Leandro in person but the communication with him was swift and without problems. The key was prepared for us at the reception. The appartment was basic but clean and its location is perfect for exploring the city and close to the metro station Catete.
O lugar é muito bem localizado, próximo ao metrô e a praia! O apartamento é do tamanho ideal e o Leandro foi bem solícito!!!

Adoramos o apartamento do Leandro! Localização excelente, perto de tudo, muito simples de chegar e seguro. O apartamento muito aconchegante, tinha tudo que precisávamos, ficamos muito a vontade! Leandro foi ótimo anfitrião, muito atencioso! O prédio muito bonito com uma arquitetura antiga, porteiros educados! Enfim, ótima experiência, passamos dias muito tranquilos! Com certeza queremos voltar!!
Leandro was very hospitable. His place has everything we needed for our stay. Great location, next to Flamengo Park and close to a metro station.

Leandro a toujours été disponible pour répondre rapidement aux questions. Il a grandement facilité l'arrivée dans le logement. 
Le quartier est très agréable a proximité des commerces et de la plage.

O anfitrião foi super atencioso e constantemente preocupado com nosso bem estar.
Mesmo não o conhecendo pessoalmente, devido ao nosso próprio atraso em chegar na casa, ele foi super presente e facilitou ao máximo todos os nossos passos.
O apartamento é prático e bastante (Website hidden by Airbnb) certeza, em minha próxima viagem ao Rio de Janeiro, tentarei conhecer o Leandro pessoalmente e me hospedarei novamente em seu espaço.

Leandro was a great and friendly host. The place is tidy and cozy. It's really close to the city centre. It's safe and private. I loved staying in Leandro's flat. The communication with the host was smooth and non-problematic. I would definitely recommend you to stay in his place.
Leandro is very communicable and flexible. The apartment had everything we needed and was quite comfortable.
Ótimo custo benefício.  Localização boa,  bem perto de duas estações de metrô, permitindo acesso fácil tanto às praias quanto ao centro.

Predio seguro, ap de fundos sem barulho. Cama, travesseiros e toalhas de primeira linha, tudo muito confortavel. 5 min a pe do metro. Comunicacao com o anfitriao rapida e clara. Voltarei a me hospedar no ap do Leandro certamente
Comunicar com o Leandro é muito fácil e rápido... O flat é bem localizado, próximo a estação do metro do catete. Está foi a segunda vez que me hospedei no flat; recomendo.

Leandro's place is great! The location is amazing, you are so close to many places, and to the tube! It is a very small but good place to sleep. I loved the bed linen! The bed is amazingly comfortable and the shower is good! It is just a place to sleep, as it is small. But you will have a good night of sleep in a good location of the city! I recommend!
amei ficar no ap do Leandro. é como nas fotos, pequeno, mas pra mim foi o ideal. bairro muito bom com restaurantes próximos. bem perto da praia. quero voltar logo.

Para quem conhecer o Rio o apartamento para duas pessoa é ótimo. Pequenino, mas num prédio ótimo, local fantástico, junto ao metrô e ônibus, Parque do Flamengo e Palácio do Catete. Leandro é um anfitrião perfeito, pontual e preciso. Nada nos faltou.
O Leandro foi sempre muito atencioso, o local é ótimo, pertinho de tudo. Meu esposo e eu só andávamos a pé! Super recomendo! Próxima ida ao RJ certeza que nos hospedaremos com o Leandro.

Ameiiiii o lugar!!!!
Pertinho de tudo, o apê é super limpinho e organizado para a chegada do hóspede e o Leandro é um fofo, mega atencioso.
Super recomendo e quando voltar ao RJ irei alugar novamente.
O espaço é bem limpo e seguro! Tem vários itens de praticidade: frigobar, pia, fogão de duas bocas e cama de casal. Banheiro bom, ducha quente, enfim! Pequeno e pratico! Adorei!
Ótimo  lugar, vizinhos  super simpáticos e o  Leonardo  é  bem atencioso.

O apartamento é  bem funcional.  Pequeno mas possui tudo que precisamos.  Tudo muito limpo. Banheiro super limpo, roupas de cama e  toalhas limpas e bem cheirosas(isso para mim é  um diferencial) possui restaurante  perto,  fácil  acesso a praia,  bem localizado. Eu recomendo!!!  Voltarei em breve!!!

El apartamento es pequeño pero confortable, la cama es fabulosa, la Cocina tiene utensilios basicos para preparar cosas rapidas, la ubicacion es excelente ya que esta muy cerca a dos estaciones del metro, El edificio es tranquilo los porteros son muy amables y a pesar de que no hablan Español hicieron lo possible para ayudarnos

Para aqueles que desejam ficar no RJ a localização é sensacional. Tudo perto: supermercados, restaurantes e metrô. O anfitrião  concede uma atenção especial. O prédio é residencial, silencioso e o ar condicionado muito bom. Recomendo.
Ótima localização, Flat fiel as fotos e o Leandro é um excelente anfitrião, atencioso e esteve sempre disponível. Voltaria agora mesmo rs
Localização muito boa.
Excelente localização! Local tranquilo e aconchegante! Recomendo!
Ótima localização, apartamento idêntico ao descrito. Leandro é uma pessoa muito gentil e auxiliou em tudo o que tive dúvidas.

We spent 1 week at Zuleyha's apartment. She was very welcoming and friendly. Apartment's location cant be any better. its only couple of minutes from lively Istiklal street, it is well protected from the crowd; and its very quite and safe. We traveled to the most of the city from here on foot. We also took metro and tram which were quite close too. We were also walking within the neighborhood which is full of beautiful and trashy historical houses, arty shops and cafes. The room had a nice view from the window, bright and very quite. The whole apartment was very clean.

The time we stayed at Züleyha's place was very precious. We learned a lot about life in Istanbul and the culture. Her experience as a tour-guide helped us save a lot of trouble and money. We also enjoyed chatting with her and she also took my wife to her belly dance class once. She also showed us how Turkish Tea is boiled and she knows where the good restaurants are. Thank goodness we didn't take an apartment in the old town where all the prices are for tourists. We were five minutes walking distance from the main live centre in Istanbul, where the students and young people are spending their time in the evenings. And it was only three tram stations from the old town centre. We really had a great time with Züleyha.

Flat: Spacious, well decorated, very colorful like istanbul, clean, good collection of books, maps and DVDs in lounge and great collection herbal teas and coffee in kitchen, balcony with nice view of french place gardens and walls 

Room: Clean and comfy bedding, small cupboard, window with nice view of gardens

Location: Just less than 5 mins walk from the lively and most happening place of the city - İstiklâl street. But still very quite and residential. Very close to Taxi stand (1 min walk) and Tophane, Galatasary, Tunel and Taksim stations. Location is filled with cafe, bar, restaurant; shopping, embassies, historical buildings, so spend a day for new-city. Easy and quick access to old-city and asia-side thru public transportation Tram/Ferry

Host (Zuleyha): Very friendly and helpful over entire stay. Being in tourism industry and localite, she has provided lots of information and tips about istanbul (esp shops) which can not be sourced anywhere from (Hidden by Airbnb) . She and friend/neighbor prepared a nice breakfast and lots of various great herbal teas for us

Summary: Me and my wife stayed for 4 nights and had a very pleasant and enjoyable stay in March (Phone number hidden by Airbnb)

We stayed four days at Cozy Flat and it was amazing! The flat is  very clean and organized and Züleyha is thoughtful and helped us a lot with touristic information. We also had the opportunity to talk to her and found out more about Istambul and people. 
The location is very convenient! Although it looks like difficult to find it the first time.

Time with Zule and her friends is definitely one of the highlights of my trip in Istanbul. Besides all the good things other visitors mentioned, I also feel very fortunate to have a chance to experience the daily life of young professionals in Istanbul. The very first thing she did after we met is to invite me to join her and her friends for a authentic Turkish breakfast! :) After typical tourism topics we also talked a lot about each other's culture and traveling experiences, etc. I would certainly recommend Zule and her neighbor to any of my friends traveling to Istanbul. And, girl I would see you soon on my next trip in Turkey. All the Bests, Beaux

I had a fantastic stay with Zuleyha last weekend. The apartment is really well kept, and the bedroom was bright and comfortable. Zuleyha was an excellent host, gave lots of really great advice (the dance show at the cultural centre is highly recommended) and took us out for night out to see some local live music. She even showed me how to belly dance!
Did I mention that I was fed delicious home baked pastries by her lovely neighbour(also a airBnB host) every 20 minutes?

Zühleyha has a very nice and clean appartment on a perfect location in Istanbul. 
She herself was not present during our stay so we didn't get to meet her, which was a pity as we use Airbnb mainly because we like meeting local people. Zühleyha did arrange for a friend of her to be present in the house when we arrived, which worked out perfectly fine. I would definitely recommend staying in this appartment.

The apartment is great. It is just a 10 minutes walk from Taksim square and it is located in a great neighborhood. Even though great nightlife a so close, the apartment is in a very quite area.
Züleyha was away for a business trip, but her friend took care of us, who provided us with very helpful tips and advises about Istanbul We had a great stay.

It's been a very pleasurable stay at Zul's apartment - it's as central as it gets, within walking distance of many of the namable restuarants and bars, and first and foremost it's clean, neat and nice to live in. The apartment is also very quiet, with a backyard balcony that's right in front of the Italian Consulate Generale, a fully equipped kitchen and a spacious, cool living room. Host Zul is a very, very helpful, accomodating person, although she hasn't been around the apartment most of the time of our stay. Besides us, there has been another German couple living with us for a couple of days in the 2nd room. Friendly people, although it might have been nice to know up front who else we'd be sharing the apartment with. A minor flipside is that the apartment is a little hard to find, since there're no nametags on any of the bell buttons. But the minute you're there, you'll be able to be looking forward to a great and unforgettable stay at the heart of the city of Istanbul!

When we arrived delayed in Züleyha's flat she welcomed us with warm chai and homemade pastry. We felt very comfortable all the time and  were happy to could share a glass of wine with our host. Furthermore, all the advices and recommendations she gave us helped us a lot.
We could reach almost everything walking from the flat.
To sum up: very nice atmosphere and host, perfectly located and very recomendable! :-)
The flat is great, and also the localisation. Züleyha couldn't be there for profesional reasons, but all was perfect, and contact by messages wery good.

Züleyha was away for a few days (because of work commitment) when I arrived, but she arranged for someone to be there to let me in - unfortunately I got caught up in a bit of a riot on arrival in Taksim Square and didn't arrive at the apartment till 9 pm. Züleyha had left a good collection of books on Istanbul and I bought a detailed map when I was there.
The room was clean, the bed comfortable. A couple of coat hangers would have been useful.
Location was good - 5 minutes walk (uphill - so if you have knee or foot problems, be aware) to İstiklâl street and only a few minutes walk (downhill) to the tramstop at Tophane - for 3 Lira you can travel across the bridge to the Hippadrome, the Blue Mosque, Hagai Sophie etc. Alternatively you can walk - if it is not too hot, the walk is pleasant. Lots of places to eat nearby. From the ferry (not far from the tram - you can (for 3 Lira) go over to Asia - at Karidoy.

Züleyha is easy going and provided you are fair and thoughtful you will have no problems. On my last night her lovely neighbour - Gushane - prepared an evening meal for us and a few other friends. It was a great end to a lovely stay. Thank you to Züleyha and her friends for a delightful end to an exciting and happy holiday.

I have spent 4 days at Züleyha's apartment and it was a great time. The apartment is really well-located! It's in the heart of Beyoglu and the pedestrian street 'Istiklal' is 5 min away. There are nice shops, cafés and restaurants in close area. 
Züleyha as a host was absolutely great! She has a real good insight when it comes to sights and places which are worth visiting. She can also give you some great advice on bars and nightclubs.
The apartment is nicely decorated and she has a very nice balcony with a view on a French palace. 
It was fun to stay at her place and I can really recommend it to everyone!

Me and my boyfriend had a wonderful time in Istanbul and at Züleyha´s appartment.
She couldn´t be there because of work but her friend took care of us and was really helpful and gentle. Also the "american Girl" was a great roommate.
I would recommend this place to everyone who likes a nice, quiet place near all the Hotspots of Istanbul.
Close to Tram, Taksim, Galat-Tower.
And: Visit Limonlu bahce, best place around the corner.

Züleyha was traveling, so her friend Emrah let me in and got me set up. They were both very hospitable, and patient when my flight was delayed and I arrived late. The flat was quite comfortable, and right in the middle of Taksim (and a short walk from a metro station), which was great for walking places and getting around. 

(Warning to light sleepers, though, the entire district is pretty loud at night. I was glad to have some earplugs, as I'm not used to that much activity in the early morning.)

I stayed at Zuleyha's for 3 nights in July 2014. The place was conveniently located, a short uphill walk from the main st of Taksim. The room was small and basic. The room was noisy, very hot and there were also cats from neighbouring flats who would jump through the window in the middle of the night, so if you are precious about your sleep or don't like cats I wouldn't recommend it! Zuleyha did provide some tips on where to eat and what to do. She had just arrived back from a trip so the place was not clean or tidy when I stayed, but maybe it was just a one off.

Zuleyha is absolutely great. A professional tour guide in Turkey and all over Europe! Compliments for her knowledge and the way she treated us. 

We have a travel agency ourselves in Costa Rica but if each AirBNB is like this one, we would only recommend such places in the future. 

Thanks Zuleyha!

Renee and Ed

Vielen Dank noch einmal an Züleyha für die tolle Unterkunft. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Ein kleines gemütliches Zimmer zum schlafen sowie ein Wohnzimmer mit ausreichend Platz und einem schönen Balkon mit Aussicht ins Grüne. 

Die Unterkunft liegt sehr zentral allerdings in einer weniger einladenden Seitenstraße in Taksim und war der perfekte Startpunkt die Gegend zu erkunden. 

Leider musste unsere Gastgeberin beruflich verreisen, wir haben Sie aber für zwei Stunden bei unserer Anreise noch gesehen und sie hat uns wirklich viele wertvolle Tipps zur Besichtigung der Stadt gegeben. Da wir Katzen lieben, haben uns Ihre zwei kleinen Mitbewohner sehr viel Freude bereitet. 

Kurzum: Wir können die Wohnung und Züleyha als Gastgeber sehr empfehlen.
Zül was a great host very helpful and nice. Here apartment is lovely and in a good location; the highlight were here two kittens who made us feel at home.
The room is clean and the host is very nice,She gives us some advises,like how to go to the airport and bazaar. and i love her cats!
The house of Zühleyha is in a great area with nice streets with shops and bars. The tramstation Tophane is nearby.
Great stay, great host! Perfect location! Everything was perfect in this wonderful city

Dès notre arrivée, et l'accueil chaleureux d'Alexandra, on se sentait "chez nous". Elle nous a donné des instructions facile à comprendre sur tous les gadgets (wifi, sound dock, television et lecteur de dvd, machine à laver et sèche linge ) suivi par les bons tuyaux pour profiter de la ville en peu de temps, où manger localement (Mundo deli ---top) et comment se rendre à la plage en metro. 
La maison sur deux étages est superbe. Nous avons aimé le mélange de la pierre et des parquets en bois. Tout est neuf.
Elle est équipée avec tout ce que l’on peut vouloir. La cuisine est fantastique. Elle se prolonge par une terrasse où l’on peut prendre le petit déjeuner ou déjeuner. Cette terrasse donne sur un petit jardin plein de plantes et de petits arbres.
Tout est décoré avec goût. C’est sobre et élégant. Tout ce que nous aimons. Des lampes et des meubles design ou vintage dans chaque pièce. Un salon immense, haut de plafond avec des volets intérieurs, donne la sensation de l'espace mais reste intime. 
Nous avons aimé la possibilité de manger ou prendre un verre dans le salon, ou la cuisine, ou le terrasse ou le jardin. 
Confort des chambres et les salles de bains: simplement parfait. Et les draps sont si confortables que je pensais être dans un hôtel 5 étoiles. 
Située en pleine ville la maison reste tranquille et bien placée.

Nous avons passé un moment merveilleux à Porto. On peut voir que cette ville est en pleine ébullition. Et la maison était comme une oasis de paix à quelques minutes du centre-ville. Tout d’abord, la rua do Almada, où elle se trouve, est une rue passionnante. Des boutiques vintage ou design, sont à côté d’autres endroits qui vendent des produits électriques pour artisans comme nous n’en voyons plus à Paris. Nous avons été si bien accueillis par Alexandra qui s’occupe de la maison. Elle parle un français parfait et l’anglais aussi. Elle nous a donné plein de bonnes informations pour profiter de Porto. La maison, elle-même est magnifique. Elle vient juste d’être rénovée. Nous avons adoré la pierre que la propriétaire a sauvegardée sous les fenêtres et autour des portes et les volets typiques à l’intérieur. La décoration est très soignée. Là aussi, un mix d’objets très design, comme la superbe lampe dans la cuisine ou dans le salon et des petits meubles vintage un peu partout, très beaux. La cuisine est un bonheur. On pouvait prendre notre petit déjeuner sur la terrasse qui donne sur un petit jardin adorable où l’on peut descendre par un large escalier. Nous avions un grand choix de vaisselle magnifique. Les chambres sont aussi très confortables. Chacune avait sa salle de bains. Mais le must, c’est les draps. Nous avons eu l’impression de dormir dans un hôtel 5 étoiles. Douillets et soyeux à souhait. J’aimerais avoir les mêmes chez moi ! La bibliothèque du salon contient plein de livres intéressants et une bonne collection de dvd. On s’est senti chez nous, avec un certain luxe en plus ! C’est sûr, nous reviendrons à Porto et dans cette maison qui nous a touchés. Le séjour était trop court, comme toujours…

We loved staying at Zahia's place.  Alexandra welcomed us very warmly and gave us good tips about Porto. The house ist very well furnished and there is nothing at all we were missing. More – we loved the design and everything  including the dishes of villeroy & boch. We felt like at home! 
Everything is new and clean. Also the beds are very comfortable - in addition it's a quiet neighborhood and we slept very well. We were very lucky to find a place like this and can recomend it to everyone. 
We'll be back...

This was the best house we have stayed so far for the Portugal/Spain trip. Zahia house was really very neat, tidy, spacious and tastefully decorated. Her friend was there for the check in. He was such a great help and host. I highly recommend Zahia house if u and your friend are in Porto and would like to do some cooking and enjoying by the backyard with wine.  Also not to mention, u can walk by foot to a lot of places from Zahia house between 15-20mins, and a lot of eateries just 2-3mins walk from her place.

The appartment is very well located, very conveniet, fully equipped.
We have been welcome, and provided with lot of tips (best locations to have lunch, to go shopping or to enjoy pasteries and drinks.  So much that we preferred not use the kitchen so as to enjoy the portuguese food (even the vegetarian!).
We warmly recommend this location.

I would return to Porto just to repeat the experience of my visit to Zahia's home in the old city of Porto!

Every step of the process, from making first contact to sadly having to say goodbye, was a pleasure.  Such beautiful energy and style. Thank you so much Zahia, Alexandra and Diogo for your kindness, care and assistance. Also very much enjoyed meeting some of your lovely friends in the neighbourhood at Mondo Deli. 

A word of warning though when staying at Zahia's home, her beds are so comfortable, they will wrap their silky sheets around you and not want to let you go  : ) zzzz

Could not recommend more highly to visit Porto and Zahia's home.

Obrigado

: ) errol

Exactly as described. Communication was excellent and host was flexible with check in & out with regard to leaving our bags at the house. V clean in general with a very well equipped kitchen. Great location for exploring Porto.

Wir waren zu dritt, zwei Erwachsene und ein Kind. Es gibt zwei Schlafzimmer. Das Haus ist traumhaft! Genau so grosszügig und wunderbar eingerichtet wie auf den Fotos. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt und Alexandra hat für uns vorab sogar einen Parkplatz um die Ecke reserviert. Wir wurden herzlich mit einer Flasche Wein empfangen. Danke an die Gastgeber!

Zahia and her wonderfully helpful friend Alexandra provided the most fantastic welcome via their friend Diogo. He gave us all the best restaurant tips and was so helpful. The house itself was absolutely gorgeous, and in a fabulous area, close to the city. The garden also was a lovely place to relax in. Would wholeheartedly recommend staying in this memorably beautiful home!

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Alexandra, qui nous a donné d'excellents conseils en matière de lieux à visiter et de restaurants sympathiques. Elle a été toujours facile à contacter durant notre séjour. Cette maison de ville est agréable et très bien située dans le quartier historique de Porto. La maison était très propre à notre arrivée. Sa situation permet de visiter  la ville à pieds ou en transport en commun facilement. Porto est une belle cité qui monte et descend en permanence.   Très bon séjour, nous recommandons cette jolie maison à qui veut visiter Porto.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis. Nous avons eu de très bon conseils (restaurants, lieux de visite, etc.) pour agrémenter notre séjour.

Le logement est très bien placé dans un quartier encore peu touristique. Quelques restaurants et bars branchés se sont installés dans le quartier. Ce n’est pas forcément la peine d’aller loin pour sortir le soir.

Le logement est très bien équipé et tout est neuf. La literie est très bonne.

This is a roomy, light, and well-equipped apartment. There is a lovely private garden area and a balcony over-looking the garden. Everything was as described, including very comfortable beds.

The neighborhood is within walking distance of everything in the historic area of the city and is also a few blocks walk from the Metro. There are several grocery stores and cafes, bakeries and restaurants close by.

Our host, Zahia, and her assistant, Alexandra, were gracious and helpful. Alexandra made certain that we had a taxi waiting for us at our 4 AM departure. 

Great apartment, great city, and great hosts.

The stay at Zahia's place was just perfect. The house is charming .. the neighbourhood was what we where looking for .. quiet, far from the crowds still very much in the old city, with lovely restaurants and coffee places nearby ... we loved it !!!

Wir haben tolle Tage in Porto verbracht. Das Haus von Zahia ist wunderschön renoviert, perfekt ausgestattet und liegt sehr zentral in der Altstadt. Da es teilweise schon kühl war, waren wir auch froh um die Heizung. Das Haus hat alles was man braucht. Alles im Zentrum war gut zu Fuss zu erreichen und für Orte weiter weg, wie der Strand etc, ist die Busstation nicht weit weg. In der Nähe sind Supermarkt, Restaurants, Bars und Cafes und viele kleine Geschäfte. 
Alejandra hat uns herzlich empfangen und uns sehr gute Tipps und Empfehlungen gegeben. Herzlichen Dank für Alles!

Zahia's house is warm, quiet and confortable. The decoration and furnitures will make every one feeling home. The terrace and the whole house is perfect to chill after the walks through the up and down city of Porto.

The house is perfect with a spacious, beautiful interior and a magical small garden. The location is ideal with everything in walking distance including good food shopping and restaurants but the block is just far enough from the center to feel calm.

Accueil sympathique, localisation sympathique.
Appartement extraordinaire, beau, grand, propre, de bon goût.
Merci Zahia et Alexandra!

La casa è ancora più bella di come sembra nelle foto, è molto spaziosa, luminosa e silenziosa e soprattutto è originale e con grande personalità. La zona e  vicina al centro ma tranquilla. Le collaboratrici di Zahia attente e sollecite. Ottima esperienza, se torneremo a Porto torneremo qui!

An old house in the centre of Porto that was converted one year ago. Beautifully converted with good sized accommodation on two floors - a large kitchen, and separate lounge on the first floor, and two good sized en suite bedrooms on the second floor. Very clean and perfect high quality accommodation for visiting Porto. We had a great time and we would recommend highly this property.

La anfitriona fue muy amable, nos recomendó varios lugares para salir y comer, y fueron todo un acierto. 
La casa está muy bien ubicada, cerca del centro histórico (menos de 5 minutos andando) de forma que te permite recorrer toda la ciudad sin necesidad de utilizar el transporte público.  Además, la casa tiene encanto.

The flat is perfect, well equipped, nice terrace, stylish, and close to nearly everything. Supermarket, bakery etc. are reachable in 3 minutes. A good bakery - cristo rei - is a lit bit away, direction Mercado Balhao (the Mercado ist closed until at least 2019, due to a complete renovation), while my family was still sleeping I had an expresso here every morning, a small breakfast snack and always good conversation with the locals. Public transport is nearby, 3 minutes by foot to Trinidade, the main metro station, all metro lines pass this station. 

The house is amazing and you feel at home immediately , if the weather is bad or you just want to chill a few hours there are lot of books, movies and a music box. The flat is very clean and everything is in a very good condition. There is enough space for four adults, or a family of four / five, two bathes and a third toilet are luxury, and useful. 

Alexandra who represented the owner Zahia is very helpful, charming and made it possible that we could check in very late at 23.30. Her advices are very useful. Patricia, the architect, who renovated this small and outstanding house, runs her bureau on the ground floor in a small office. If you need any advice or help, Patricia will help you immediately. 

You won't find a more pleasant flat for your days in Porto - you can also discover the north of Portugal with a base in Porto: The railway station Sao Bento is a 9 minute walk away (downhill) and is very good connected to Braga, Douro Valley, surf beaches and so on.

This was the second time that my husband and I stayed at Zahia's house because we fell in love with it the first time (which was two years ago), and we couldn't resist staying again! The house is gorgeous; it has spacious rooms, bright skylights, and a wonderful back garden. We slept in the master bedroom, which is situated on the top floor at the back of the house, so it is quiet at night. Alexandra is the manager of the house, and she is very responsive, professional, and kind. This is a gem in Porto!
Nice but, no hobs or oven in kitchen.

tudo conforme o anuncio, bom local, limpo e proximo, mas o anfitrião tem que melhorar o aparelho de ar condicionado, pois não está funcionando a contento, quando fizer mais calor, ficará bem dificil dormir no imovel.
tudo normal nada de mas  localiçao e otima
O local é muito bom para que está na correria do trabalho, satisfaz as necessidades...

Farouq is an excellent host, when we arrived he showed us places where we can eat, shop, and different ways to arrive home. 
The apartment is beautiful, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, one kitchen, small but independent and has everything you need. It was also very clean. 
You can always find Farouq by (Hidden by Airbnb) , he helps you with every question. 
The apartment is in a good location, close to the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and other interesting points. 
The wifi is not so good. 
Thanks for everything, magic city.
Clean and pleasant accommodation. Well located to visit many monuments.
Excelente lugar y servicios. Cerca de lugares históricos, restaurantes y transporte público.
We had a great vacation and Farouq is very good host. the apartment is clean and very welcoming. We recommend.

The perfect combination. Price and quality. The apartment is clean and comfortable. The location is excellent. A picturesque authentic area. 10 minutes to Sultanahmet. In the quarter where the apartment prices in restaurants are lower than in tourist places. Nearby great places. Excellent breakfast in Ziya Baba Turk Mutfagi.Inexpensive and tasty hookah in Reggae BR Shot & Food. Farouq quickly answers and solves the problems.

I have stayed in Pinar's apt at Kurdela Sok for 8 nights in June 2012. She told me that I was her first renter via this website after the students who rented the apt before had left. It's located in a lively and colorful and relatively poor popular neighborhood, in which it is one of the very few renovated buildings. This means that you get in touch with the life of real Istanbul people that you normally might not meet as a tourist in the regular tourist aereas. It is very near very well known and touristy aeras as Taksim Square, Istanbul's main shopping street Istakal Caddesi and the major aera with bars, cafés and clubs (all 5-10 mins walking). On Sundays there is a nice and busy market on the street. Lively means also quite noisy: bring your earplugs if you want to sleep early or sleep in the morning. 
The apartment itself has been renovated in a simple and tasteful way: wooden floor, simple but adequate bathroom and kitchen 
tyhe only inconvenience I acn think of is that the bathroom floor isn't perfectly inclined to the shower drain, in a way that the bathroom floor remains partly wet. The absence of airconditioning is not a problem, since the large number of windows make that there is enough ventilation. Pinar has been very kind: she even left some food and drinks in the fridge. 
Last but not least: istanbul is a great cuity, which will make your stay unforgettable!

We had a really nice time in Istanbul and enjoyed to stay at Pinars flat. It is in walking distance from the main shopping area around Istiklal and Taksim Square. The street and area is very lively (also in the evenings) and there is a local market on Kurdela Sokak on sundays.

The flat itself is very nice, but staying there in the middle of summer with 35 C, air-condition would be a nice upgrade.

A clean and nice flat in the center of Istanbul.
Close to accomodations.
Pinar is a friendly host.
You have laundry,little balcony etc.
The area can be very busy during the market and sometimes a bit noisy in the evening.
Good spot!!
Расскажите другим участникам сообщества Airbnb о вашей поезкде. Это будет показано на странице объявления.

Pinar's place is a cute, well-renovated house in a working class neighborhood near Taxim pedestrian area. The place is spotless, only hiccup is that it does not have ac, however if you are visiting out of season it should not be a problem. Pinar is a cool host. She responded to our last minute request and since she lives in the sme building she was superflexible with check-in/out. She was really nice and helpful.

We can only affiliate with the previous reviews. Pinar`s flat is comfortably furnished, clean and excellently located. We spent a wonderful time in Istanbul and can only recommend Pinar`s "cosy flat".

Pinar's apartment is very well renovated, comfortable and clean. We had a very pleasant stay! The flat is located in an authentic, non-touristic Istanbul neighbourhoods which we enjoyed very much. Pinar is a very quick responding and nice host. She organised all we needed for a good stay, and there was a lack of nothing! We would select the flat again.

we had a wonderfull time in pinars apartment.
the flat is situated in a very original part of istanbul, which i find great.
off the beaten track, this is where you really get to know turkey.
especially the market is fascinating and super tasty.
the perfect place for two, if you are looking to stay in istanbul from one night to a year!

The apartment of Pinar was very cosy, nice and clean. It felt immediately like home. It was a very great location in a neighborhood very close to the Istiklal Cadessi and Taksim, but far enough from the real tourist area. Wednesday, there was a market in the street, with a lot of fresh fruit and vegetables. If we come to Istanbul ever again, we will certainly book this great flat. Pinar and her friend were also very helpfull!

The flat looks exactly like in the pictures: very clean, newly renovated and sunny. The area is a quiet, non-touristic neighborhood, but only a 10 minutes walk from the frenzy of Istiklal Caddesi. We enjoyed it very much, especially the Sunday market. We did not meet Pinar, but her her friend Firat welcomed us to the flat. Everything was perfect and I would definitely recommend the flat!

The flat was really the same as the pictures show - it is very cosy! Also the equipment of it was very good - the kitchen had everything you need. There was even a hair dryer in the flat. We also used the washing machine in the basement which enabled us to keep our luggage small. Which was important to us as we spent there 3,5 weeks and with two children (3 years, 8 months). Pinar and Firad were so nice and gave us extra mattresses that we put on the floor so that the four of us could stay in this apartment. 
It was also great to have WLAN which worked pretty well.

Opposite the apartment there is a small grocery store (and several more in the street) where we bought most of our food. Generally, the people were very friendly in the neighbourhood, a neighbourhood with "normal" people, not touristic at all. Which we liked a lot and was also one reason why we took this flat. Secondly, it was the location of it: maybe a 15min. walk to Beyoglu. 

It was very easy to communicate with Pinar, she was very accommodating so that we would love to be her guests again. Next time...! 
çok teşekkürler!

The apartment is great and in a really good location! The market on Sunday is amazing. Firat was a great help and suggested places to eat and go in the evenings! He also came and rescued us when I locked us out of the flat!

We spent an amazing 3 weeks in Istanbul.  The location, the flat, the wifi, the neighbourhood - everything was awesome.  The flat is huge and there is a lot of room to relax, work, rest, or people watch at the windows!  The water was shut off one day - but that had nothing to do with the flat as it was the whole neighbourhood.  The flat isn't exactly as it is in the pictures - it is definitely more worn than they appear, but still a great place. The market on sunday is an added bonus - as are the hills to help burn off some of the cheese we ate! :)  I would love to stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone. Thanks again Pinar!

+  The apartment is sweet
+  There are 5 other People who are very nice
+  During the day the neighborhood is nice
- at night it was very spooky, their are many men on the street
+  Dining options and Shops, very good, lots of people to help you learn Turkish if you  like
-  For this area the rent is to much (we were their for 5 months)
-  in winter it is very cold in the Apartment, the Windows are not good, when it rains, it's damp inside, it is very windy.
- Tarlabasi has Problems with electricity and water supply
- in the garden their are a lot of cats, sometimes they became disruptive to my sleep

We stayed at Pinars place for about 6 months, and absolutely loved it! The apartment has the best location imaginable, close to the center and with a wonderful sunday market right outside the door.

The area is super charming and has some of the tastiest and cheapest food around. Highly recommended!!

Pinar was an excellent hostess. She was home from Kenya during our visit, and even took us around the city and out to a Turkish dinner. Wonderful!

The apartment is as listed - it is lovely, clean, bright, and big. It's on a quiet street, very comfortable, and has all amenities you might need. There is a wonderful street market outside on Sundays. 

Wifi is 3-8MBS, but that is common throughout Turkey. I would recommend getting a SIM card with 3G to tether if you need fast Internet. 

One issue to know before you book: This apartment is solidly in the ghetto. It is very close (3 blocks) to the nice, touristy part of town. But make no mistake - this is the ghetto. Example: A homeless guy slept in our doorway for 3 nights (Pinar's friend quickly took care of this), and there was presumably human feces left by this homeless man outside our door for a few days.

So while this place was fine for us, just be aware of the location - I would not recommend this spot for families with small children, or anyone who feels uncomfortable around overt poverty. It is not dangerous, however. I never felt unsafe - the area is just unclean, and there are a lot of squatters. 

So if you're ok with an area with "character" - this apartment will be perfect for you! Overall very nice and exactly what we expected.

We stayed in Pinar’s apartment for 1 month in December and January. We found the apartment to be clean and bright and very much like the photos. Pinar was visiting from Kenya and we had the opportunity to meet her. She was very friendly and was quick to clear a couple of issues with the house when we moved in. The kitchen was adequate and we were able to prepare our meals in the house. There are stores nearby but selections are not great and visits to multiple stores might be necessary to find what you need. The washing machine on the lower level was a welcome addition. As others have done, I would have to mention that the neighborhood could be seen as rundown and difficult for some. The apartment is located a short distance from Istiklal Avenue, however the hill up to Istiklal is very steep and you have to walk in the busy road most of the way. It could be seen as dangerous to some. We also found public transportation difficult unless you first walk to either Taksim Square or Tunel Funicular which are both nearly 20 minutes away. There is a tram on Istiklal but it is not reliable. The neighborhood can be noisy, but we found it to be nice when we met people in shops in the neighborhood. The Sunday market outside the door would be a highlight for anyone visiting.

This lovely house is in a unique and must seen historic neighborhood in Beyoglu. We really enjoyed being 4-5 minutes away from the mid point of the most famous avenue called Istiklal Street. The hosts  are kind and nice people. It's the right choice if you want to enjoy your visit in Istanbul.

+Good location, confortable flat, kindness host family+  The flat located 5min from Omer Hayyam bus stop,10 min from Istiklal street,20min from Taksim or Sishane metro stations on foot. Many small supermarkets are around the apartment. Every sunday we can see big street market in front of the door.  Rooms are clean and pretty same as photos. I stayed in winter time, it was snowing it was so cold outside, but inside was warm by heating machine. Also there was a airconditioner in bed room, but I didn't have to use it. Enough speed wi-fi, foldable dining table(I used this as a big pc desk), enough kitchin stuffs were there. I really relaxed in this flat.  Thank you Pinar!!

I stayed at Pinar's apartment three plus weeks for what amounted to a very comfortable stay. The apartment itself is excellent value -- spacious, cozy, & with everything you should need. I loved spending hours reading on the cushions in the bay windows overlooking the street. It's very well located less than a ten minute walk from Beyoglu and Taksim. The neighbourhood's somewhat rough character could be an issue for some people, but really, they shouldn't be put off -- everyone I came across was friendly and I never felt unsafe. Tarlabasi is a lively, fascinating area, with one of Istanbul's more interesting stories. One night I was invited to join in the dancing at a Kurdish wedding celebration just down the street. The shopkeeper with the food stall across the way was unfailingly helpful. And Sunday mornings are a nice surprise when the entire street is given over to a market, which is when I did most of my grocery shopping. (You step out the front door and there's a guy selling olives or cheese or spices for the day.) When I eventually return to Istanbul I would definitely consider staying here again.
Konumu itibariyle hosnut olmasak da ev ile ilgili bir sıkıntı yaşamadık

Pictures do reflect the place, clean and new, which is in a renovated house in a slowly gentrifying area. Pinar and relatives were quickly responsive and helpful with all issues.  Will rent it again for my next long term visit.

warm and comfortable apartment in family style neighborhood ,you will feel like a local and  surprise yourself during on Sunday market, not  far from  the  touristic   area  by  walk  ,  leave  yourself    free   to  explore   around     the    unknown   part  of   historic    area  of   Beyoglu!

Pinar's flat was a disappointing experience. The main difference from the photos is the bathroom - it's really old and needs remodeling badly. I even wore flip-flops in the shower. There is no shower curtain or separation of the shower area, so water gets all over the bathroom floor. Despite what the listing said, there was no shampoo or hair dryer. The neighborhood is also rough - really poor and not somewhere I would want to walk at night alone.

We booked Pinar's flat very last-minute after another host cancelled, which was very flexible of her, but 45 minutes after booking she informed me the flat was being painted and we had to stay in another room for the first night. The "other room" turned out to be a room in her nephew's downstairs flat. We had no idea we would be sharing a flat for the first night, and the flat we booked wasn't ready until 7 pm the next evening because they hadn't cleaned it. She didn't offer us a discount or anything for staying in a shared flat instead of the one we booked, or for the very late check-in.

In summary - this place might be fine as a long-term choice for students on a budget, but if you're in Istanbul for a few days and are looking for a nice place, stay somewhere else.

Everything was ok but the appartament  is rather dark not like on the pictures , if you switch on the light it’s dim particularly in the evening , it was very cold to take a shower so we couldn’t because it was too cold ! And as for the area that was very important ! It’s like Arab district and in the evening it was not pleasant and not safe for us to come back home ! Very dirty street and if you are two girls you will be scared to come back alone ! And it is very noisy because in the morning the cars come , people cry so we didn’t sleep ! 
P.s the new phew of piñar is a good pleasant person who showed us everything
Great place to stay in Istanbul!
Pinar and Baran were very communicative and helpful. Provided me with all I needed!

Pinar's apartment is ideal for both short and long-term stays. If you enjoy walking, it is perfectly located to discover the city by foot. The place is spacious and quiet, as there is not much traffic. The market on Sundays is a particular highlight as it is literally outside the front door.
Baran, Pinar's nephew, is there to ensure that you find everything you need and is a terrific help.
I spent a month here and am happy to recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. What is more, both Pinar and Baran are extremely forthcoming and very quick to respond to any questions.

Smooth check in & out! Pinar & Baran were very responsive and helpful!
Very cosy apartment! Thanks a lot.
Very nice, good value!
Very nice flat in a popular area, close to buses from/to both airports. Baran was really nice and helpful. The flat was clean and looks like the pictures. We recommend it!

Grand appartement ! Un cadre idéal pour des vacances ! Prêt d'une rue assez passante, la chambre est située du côté opposé donc parfait ! (pour les oreilles sensibles comme moi, je conseille tout de même les boules quies) (Website hidden by Airbnb) 10-15 minutes à pied de la grande rue menant à Taksim Square, où l'on trouve vraiment tout. L'appartement est située dans une rue descendante de la grande rue Tarlabasi, un ami m'a tout de même conseillé en tant que femme seule de ne pas trop y traîner la nuit, car on s'excentre un peu) (Website hidden by Airbnb) Le neveu de Pinar est très réactif aux questions et dispo pour aider, donc hôtes au to (Website hidden by Airbnb) Je recommande cet airbnb pour tous les couples (avec 1 enfant aussi je pense que ce serait parfait)!

I’d recommend a couple looking for a central private flat in Istanbul to stay here! The location was excellent, very close to our favourite areas of the city with hip bars and independent shops! The flat met all our basic needs, although not to the standard of a hotel we were barely in the flat as there was so much to do nearby! Pinar and Baran were very helpful and always responded quickly to any questions we had, perfect hosts. Thanks so much to both of you for letting us stay, we loved exploring the city!
Good for couples looking to for some privacy and good location to do some sightseeing and feel the Turkish way of living.
the apartment of Pinar is located not far (approx. 5 minutes by foot) from the main shopping street and is beautifully and functionally furnished.
We had a wonderful time here.

Very nice stay. Our host was really welcoming and helpful. The Appartement was really clean and conform to the description and pictures. 
I wholeheartedly recommend them

Adorable newly renovated, comfortable flat. Everything you need is provided, including a well-equipped kitchen. Pinar's nephew Baran helped us with check-in and questions, and since he lives in the building that was very easy, and he was very friendly and helpful. The immediate neighborhood feels rundown, but the flat is walking distance to restaurants, transportation, coffee shops. It's a good value for such a large place, but the tradeoff is being a little farther away from the action.

Thanks to our host for having us. Istanbul is definitely worth a trip. Pinars appartment is lovely and clean. Communication with her and Baran was easy. He helped us with first steps when we arrived. The neighborhood is not that nice but we didn‘t mind.

Pinar’s apartment is absolutely gorgeous. It is bright, clean and spacious. It is well appointed with everything you’d need for your stay. It’s located in a lively and colourful neighbourhood. There are grocery stores and restaurants nearby and a market in the street every Sunday, selling fresh produce. 
This place is wonderful, I would highly recommend a stay here.

We had a lovely stay at Pinar’s apartment during our week in Istanbul. We met her nephew, Baran, on arrival, who lives in the apartment below and was friendly, helpful and quick to respond to any queries we had during our stay. The apartment is well located, 5/10 minutes walk from the Nevizade restaurant area and bars to the South. The only thing I would recommend to other guests is to bring earplugs as the apartment is very close to a mosque. We really liked the apartment - it was exactly as the photos- clean, bright and spacious.

I stayed at Pinar's apartment in the Tarlabasi neighbourhood of Beyoglu for one month. The 1-bedroom apartment is spacious, clean and well maintained. The bed is firm, but comfortable and with radiators in every room it was sufficiently warm at night. (My stay was in the late fall, when the Istanbul weather is a little unpredictable.) The kitchen, though small, was perfect for cooking and Pinar provided nearly every kitchen item that one could need for meals small or large.

Contrary to what you might hear or read online, Tarlabasi is a safe and very interesting neighbourhood. It is very much a local area, where people live their lives, go to the local stores, drink tea for hours at the local shops, and go to the amazing and enormous Sunday market that is right on the same street as Pinar's building. It is very close to more touristy & fashionable areas (Istiklal Street, Galata, Taksim, Cihangir, Karakoy, etc.), but it is not a tourist area. So if you want a relatively quiet and relaxing place to stay, where you can see how "normal" people live in Istanbul, I'd highly recommend Pinar's apartment.

Pinar and Baran, her nephew who lives in the building, were extremely helpful and responsive to my queries. I would stay at Pinar's place again & recommend it for open-minded and thoughtful visitors to Istanbul.

Çok teşekkürler Pinar!

This apartment is one of the true treasures in Istanbul. Huge space, lots of light, perfectly decorated, comfortable bed + couch... everything was perfect. And the Sunday market is just about the most local experience you can have. When I come to Istanbul, this is the only place I will stay at. It's perfect. 

Per the comments on the neighborhood, this is the real Istanbul! None of the touristy fake stuff you'll get up on Istiklal. Families live here, chat here, hang up their colorful laundry together, so you truly do get an actual feel of the city. 

Book this place immediately, and for longer than you think.
We had a fantastic stay at Pinar's place. It is well located and many of the attractions of the city are easy to reach.

We stayed at this little quaintly situated sweetheart of an apartment for 3 nights in June and would return. Fits 2 people no problems, and the decorations surround you with a glow of warmth and style. If Location to some of Sydney's great lifestyle treats is an important point for your visit, then this place is well worth considering. See you again Serena!

I stayed at Serena's flat for two weeks in July, it's a cosy little place, perfectly located to discover the city and the thriving night life around Kings Cross and Surry Hills. Getting around from here is also quite easy - the train station of Kings Cross is just across Williams St and you have buses all around you. The flat is in the basement so no views and it can be a bit dark in winter, but in summer it won't get so hot. The kitchen has all the basic facilities you would need for a holiday stay, the bathroom is neat and everything was tidy.
Contact and Check-in/Check-out was easy and prompt, with complementary fruit, bread rolls, jam and milk to start off my stay. There is an ATM right next to the entrance and a bakery across the street, so all very handy.

Serena's apartment is tidy, comfy, attractively decorated and perfectly located just steps from bars, pubs and restaurants. She left us gift basket of jam, fruit, oatmeal and buns that was much appreciated. We could hear music from a nearby club or bar so would advise earplugs but we slept well. Great hot shower! We would definitely recommend it to others. Thanks!

Serena's place is superbly located, pretty much across the road from King's Cross, a short walk into the CBD with easy access to public transport. We stayed for a weekend, and were lucky enough to be able to check in on the Friday morning, as there hadn't been anyone staying in the apartment the night before. Serena greeted us, gave us advice about the area, and had even made us a breakfast hamper complete with home made jam!

The apartment had everything we needed, and was very nicely decorated. The only down side was a fair bit of nighttime noise, as it is located in quite a happening area and we were there over the weekend. Luckily we're not particularly light sleepers so we were still able to sleep.

Overall it was a great weekend, and we would definitely stay there again.

Serena's apartment is centrally-located and near a lot of great restaurants and bars. The coffee shop next door was really nice. Serena was a great host and greeted us with a tasty breakfast basket. The apartment itself was nice and clean although somewhat dark and the main window faced a lightly frequented alleyway so we generally kept the blinds shut. That said, it was a good place for the price and I would recommend it.

Had a really great stay at Serena's apartment.  The location was great - we arrived at Sydney airport at 9pm, by 9.30, we were meeting Serena at the apartment and by 10pm we were meeting friends at the Kings Cross Hotel down the street.  Very convenient!

The apartment was thoughtfully decorated, the breakfast was simple and nice, the bed was comfy, the bathroom clean.  No complaints!  Surprisingly quiet for the middle of the city.  Would definitely recommend!

My wife, daughter and I had an amazing time in Sydney and staying at Serena's place. 

The location is great, it is walking distance from most tourist attractions in the city (if you love a bit of walking like we do - about 25 mins walking to Opera house, Darling Harbour).  Supermarket is just around the corner. And if you are a Muslim looking for halal food, there are a couple of halal restaurants about 5 mins walk from the apartment. 

Serena's apartment is nice and cozy, the kitchen is well equipped for cooking a simple meal. 

Oh and Serena is very flexible with check-ins and check-outs; which is super helpful when travelling with a toddler. 

All in all, it is a great place to stay if you are travelling as a couple or with a small child.
I´ve been in Serena´s Place for a bit more than two weeks with my 15-year-old daughter. Everything was nice and clean and very well equipped and organized. We loved staying there. Thanks to Serena.

We had a fantastic mini break at Serena's apartment. It's a great location, very secure, nicely decorated, clean and very comfortable. Serena (and her mum, who kindly checked us in) was a very welcoming host, who was extremely responsive to any queries before and during our stay. It's right near kings cross, and we were there on the weekend, but no problems with noise, and we slept really well.
